## 0 Setup

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

base     <- "/Volumes/Storage++/Objects/Ciita Manuscript/Mouse IMEC annotation"
data_dir <- file.path(base, "Data")
res_dir  <- file.path(base, "Results")
tab_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "tables")
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

strip_suffix <- function(x) sub("-\\d+$", "", x)
```

## 1 Recluster endothelial and myeloid cells of the integrated AMI + HFrEF object

```{r}
integrated <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "Integration_All.cells_Full.annotation.rds"))

ec_my <- subset(integrated, subset = leiden_05 %in% c("2", "3", "9", "10", "11", "14"))

ndims <- min(30, ncol(Embeddings(ec_my, "X_scVI")))
ec_my <- FindNeighbors(ec_my, dims = 1:ndims, reduction = "X_scVI")
ec_my <- FindClusters(ec_my, resolution = 0.3)
ec_my <- RunUMAP(ec_my, dims = 1:ndims, reduction = "X_scVI")

DimPlot(ec_my, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE)
ggsave("UMAP_EC_Myeloid_res0.3.pdf", path = res_dir, width = 8, height = 7)

DotPlot(ec_my, group.by = "seurat_clusters",
        features = c("Cdh5", "Pecam1", "Kdr", "Prox1", "Lyve1", "Ptprc", "Runx1", "Cd68", "Ciita",
                     "H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "Cd74", "S100a8", "Adipoq"), scale = FALSE) + RotatedAxis()
ggsave("DotPlot_EC_Myeloid_res0.3_markers.pdf", path = res_dir, width = 10, height = 7)
```

## 2 Annotation (cluster 11 = IMEC)

```{r}
cluster_map <- c("0"  = "Capillary EC",
                 "1"  = "Monocytes (infiltrating)",
                 "2"  = "Monocytes",
                 "3"  = "Venous EC",
                 "4"  = "Monocytes",
                 "5"  = "Monocytes (infiltrating)",
                 "6"  = "Lymphatic EC",
                 "7"  = "Monocytes",
                 "8"  = "Neutrophils",
                 "9"  = "Capillary EC",
                 "10" = "Venous EC",
                 "11" = "IMEC",
                 "12" = "Monocytes",
                 "13" = "Aterial EC",
                 "14" = "Monocytes",
                 "15" = "Adipose cells",
                 "16" = "Capillary EC")

ec_my$cell_type <- unname(cluster_map[as.character(ec_my$seurat_clusters)])

integrated$cell_type <- as.character(integrated$cell_type)
integrated$cell_type[match(colnames(ec_my), colnames(integrated))] <- ec_my$cell_type

write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(table(integrated$cell_type, integrated$orig.ident)),
          file.path(tab_dir, "Cell_types_per_sample_integrated.csv"))

saveRDS(integrated, file.path(res_dir, "Integration_AMI.HFrEF_IMEC.Annotation.rds"))
```

## 3 Transfer IMEC label to the mouse Ctrl/HFrEF object

```{r}
hfref_int <- subset(integrated, subset = Experiment %in% "snRNA")
imec_bc <- strip_suffix(colnames(hfref_int)[which(hfref_int$cell_type == "IMEC" &
                                                  hfref_int$disease %in% c("HFrEF", "ctrl_HFrEF"))])

data <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "260608_Mouse_HF_complete.rds")) %>%
  subset(condition %in% c("Mice-CTRL", "Mice-HFrEF"))

hits <- strip_suffix(colnames(data)) %in% imec_bc

data$annotation_final <- as.character(data$annotation)
data$annotation_final[hits] <- "IMEC"

write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(table(data$annotation_final, data$orig.ident)),
          file.path(tab_dir, "annotation_final_per_sample.csv"))

saveRDS(data, file.path(res_dir, "SeuratObject_Mice_HFrEF_Ctrl.rds"))

writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(res_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
```
